senses.definition: n.f. separation—אֶל־אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה Lv 16:22 (P) unto a land of separation, of the goat for Azazel; solitary land RV; ‘cut off,’ i.e. whence it would not readily find its way back VB.
